description: Truly mixed-mode MISO universal filter (Faseehuddin et al., CSSP 2026, Fig. 3; two M-DVCCTAs, two MOS grounded resistors, R3, C1, C2; gpdk180, +/-0.9 V). Shared analogiq benchmark form of the golden replay pack testbenches/11_11_26/Filters/MISO_universal_filter/MISO_universal_filter/miso_universal_111126_task_001 (2026-11-11): the replay's five process corners, its nine retained metrics with exactly the replay's owner-approved limits (paper value with a 15 % allowance, targets.json), and its fixture (decks testbenches/<corner>/<deck>/input.scs; OCEAN extract.ocn and replay/engine9.py for the extraction). Metrics the replay excluded (core RX/RZP/ROP/ROM/OTA gm diagnostics, peak estimates, Python THD harmonics 2-10) are not targeted. No objective. User decision 2026-11-12: validity gates are bypassed for task eligibility/feasibility; all performance constraints remain enforced. Diagnostics are not a gate pass or physical qualification.

constraints.name: Y1_gain
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: replay targets.json Y1_gain (owner-approved: paper 0.99 V/V, Table 5 p89, +/-15 %), worst over the five corners. Definition (replay CORE_Y1 deck, OCEAN value(mag(getData("X" ?result "ac")) 1)): one M-DVCCTA, Y1 -> X voltage gain at 1 Hz, X loaded by 2 kohm, other ports at 0 V (paper characterization loads unspecified).

constraints.name: Y2_gain
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: replay targets.json Y2_gain (paper 0.99 V/V, Table 5 p89, +/-15 %), worst over the five corners. CORE_Y2 deck: Y2 -> X voltage gain at 1 Hz, X loaded by 2 kohm.

constraints.name: IZP_gain
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: replay targets.json IZP_gain (paper 0.998 A/A, Table 5 p89, +/-15 %), worst over the five corners. CORE_IZP deck (OCEAN value(mag(getData("ZP_SRC:p" ?result "ac")) 1)): AC 1 A into X, |I| of the 0 V source on ZP at 1 Hz.

constraints.name: MISO_BP_frequency
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: replay targets.json MISO_BP_frequency (paper design pole frequency 3.98 MHz, Section 6.1 p90, +/-15 %), worst over the five corners. VM_BP deck, 600 points/decade (golden README): first falling zero of the derivative of |V(VOUT)| with V3 driven (OCEAN cross(deriv(mag(getData("VOUT" ?result "ac"))) 0 1 "falling")).

constraints.name: MISO_quiescent_power
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: replay targets.json MISO_quiescent_power upper 5.3935 mW (paper 4.69 mW post-layout, Table 1 p77 / conclusion p111, +15 %), worst over the five corners: power of the two supply rails at zero signal (OCEAN 0.9*(-getData("VDD_SRC:p")+getData("VSS_SRC:p"))). The replay's lower limit 0 is the physical floor and is not written (a zero lower limit would give every design a margin of about 0 in the margin formula).

constraints.name: BP_noise_in
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: replay targets.json BP_noise_in upper 75.946 nV/rtHz (paper 66.04 nV/rtHz, Section 6.1 p92, +15 %), worst over the five corners: input-referred (V3) noise density of the VM band-pass at 3.98 MHz (OCEAN value(getData("in" ?result "noise") 3.98e6); paper: "in the passband", the centre frequency is the replay's assumption). Replay lower limit 0 not written (physical floor).

constraints.name: BP_noise_out
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: replay targets.json BP_noise_out upper 65.366 nV/rtHz (paper 56.84 nV/rtHz, Section 6.1 p92, +15 %), worst over the five corners: output noise density at VOUT at 3.98 MHz (value(getData("out" ?result "noise") 3.98e6)). Replay lower limit 0 not written (physical floor).

constraints.name: LP_THD
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: replay targets.json LP_THD upper 6 % (paper 6 %, Section 6.1 p90; the replay applies no allowance to this paper bound and marks it exclusive, < 6 %; analogiq limits are inclusive), worst over the five corners: VM low-pass THD for a 500 kHz, 200 mVpp sine on V2 (paper stimulus), OCEAN thd(getData("VOUT" ?result "tran") 2e-05 6e-05 8192 500000). Replay lower limit 0 not written (physical floor).
